answer: Hold every newcomer in a canyon probation zone with no trading rights until it graduates. Graduation requires endorsements from several unrelated established vertices, each spending one scarce per-epoch endorsement slot backed by its own kernel reputation. A vertex that vouches for a proven fake forfeits a slot permanently, and endorsements from one cluster count only once. Each fake therefore consumes many distinct, non-transferable slots, so an attacker cannot pool endorsements across clones.
